name: Saltmarsh Caterpillar
desc: Saltmarsh Caterpillar (Estigmene acrea): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 41 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Estigmene acrea, the salt marsh moth or acrea moth, is a moth in the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Dru Drury in 1773.
